name: trinity
author: quwisky <quwisky@qwky.eu>

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!String(process.env.npm_config_user_agent).startsWith('pnpm')) { console.error('Use pnpm for this project — run: corepack enable && pnpm install'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.spike:chromium: nx build trinity --configuration=development && node e2e/features/crypto-spike.mjs chromium
scripts.spike:webkit: nx build trinity --configuration=development && node e2e/features/crypto-spike.mjs webkit
scripts.electron:install: pnpm -C electron install && pnpm -C electron run ensure:binary
scripts.electron:build: pnpm run build && pnpm run electron:install && pnpm -C electron run build && pnpm run electron:sign:dev
scripts.electron:start: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run start
scripts.electron:package: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package
scripts.electron:package:mac: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package:mac
scripts.electron:package:mac:signed: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package:mac:signed
scripts.electron:package:linux: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package:linux
scripts.electron:package:win: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package:win
scripts.electron:package:all: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm -C electron run package:all
scripts.electron:e2e: pnpm run electron:build && pnpm exec playwright test -c e2e/playwright.electron.config.mts
scripts.android:sync: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cap sync android
scripts.android:run: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cap run android
scripts.android:build: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cap run ios
scripts.ios:build: pnpm run ios:sync && pnpm exec cap build ios --scheme App

//engines: The `>= 26` half of this range was removed rather than gaining a CI leg: nothing has ever built, tested or packaged this workspace on Node 26, so the range was advertising support that no gate backed. Widening it again is a deliberate act — add the matrix leg first (the Electron job alone rebuilds a native binary), then the range.
description: Trinity — a cross-platform Matrix client with end-to-end encryption (Angular, spartan.ng, Capacitor, Electron)
